description: This file defines the SimpleQueueAdapterCache class, which implements the IQueueAdapterCache interface. It manages cache size configuration, creates queue cache instances, and integrates with logger factories. The class is part of a streaming infrastructure within the Orleans framework, specifically for simple queue caching.

classes.name: SimpleQueueAdapterCache
classes.description: Adapter class for simple queue caches, providing cache creation and configuration handling.

methods.name: SimpleQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache size, provider name, and logger factory based on provided options and parameters.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SimpleQueueCache with specified cache size and logger, associated with the given QueueId.
